title: 8/13 silent pass: MLB Warmup status classification-locked the undelivered pick; no missed-pick alert
tier_reason: no pick was delivered for the day (delivery impact) and the missed-pick alert did not fire

contract.text: An enterable pick is delivered before the entry cutoff (first pitch minus 5 minutes of its earliest game); a day that ends with an undelivered candidate and no deliberate skip alerts the operator (E3 missed-pick alert).
contract.source: picks.SUBMISSION_CUTOFF_MIN; ARCHITECTURE.md 'Warmup / silent-pass hardening' (f0f859e); E3 missed-pick alert, scheduler step 5b

mechanism.text: classify_pick_lock_state read MLB's Warmup state (statusCode PW: abstract Live but before first pitch) as game_started_or_final and classification-locked the undelivered candidate, so delivery was skipped

the E3 missed-pick alert was gated on state.pick_locked, which the same non-delivered classification lock had set, so the alert never fired; check-pick-entered keys on scoreable commits and had nothing to check

residual.text: All in-process protections share the scheduler's fate: there is no independent cron-side day-outcome watchdog, and the no-games-day early return bypasses step 5b and EOD health.
When the detailed status lookup fails, the abstract-only fallback still treats Warmup as locked (fail-closed by design); the corrected E3 gate now alerts on that day.

watchdog.trigger: at the earliest pick game's first pitch minus 5 minutes, a candidate pick exists on disk with no delivery record (notification_sent / delivered_at), no scoreable commit and no recorded deliberate skip
watchdog.recovery_assertion: an alert is delivered (retried on failure) and the date ends with a scoreable commit or an explicit operator pass

evidence.what: 8/13: the 12:35 lineup check finished at 12:49 with the double-down game (13:10 start) in Warmup; the undelivered candidate was marked game_started_or_final, delivery was skipped and the day passed silently
E3 was gated on state.pick_locked, set by the non-delivered classification lock, so the alert never fired; check-pick-entered said 'nothing to check' all day
